requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000 pages for black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To improve customer value and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, supporting higher yield and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink formulation compatibility, bottle manufacturing, IDS system integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are released with tested yields: 6K for black, 6K+ for CMY, and CMY bottle size supports >8K pages as verified by page yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new bottles and filling system are designed for spill-free operation during user refill and service procedures.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce customer complaints, warranty claims, and improve user experience and safety.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS interface, user testing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage reported in >99% of user testing scenarios and warranty claims related to spillage do not exceed 0.1% of units sold.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Non-OEM Accessory - Foil) with a metal foiled labyrinth design and lid label, maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance security, reliability, and maintain compatibility with existing mechanisms while introducing new security features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes security and reliability tests; maintains compatibility with push-push and TDF; metal foil and lid label present as per design.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Continue using SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink formulations, with no ink reformulation required for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage existing, proven technology and reduce R&D and qualification costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank designs, IDS integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks pass all compatibility and reliability tests with new Magellan hardware.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, IDS, startup, and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure new system meets reliability, performance, and service life goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Data collection, simulation tools, IDS design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Complete reliability models and reports demonstrating compliance with HP standards for all listed parameters.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank Impact on Print Quality
requirements.Description: Perform ink stability modeling for the new tank design and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To proactively address potential print quality issues due to tank/ink interactions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling completed; no negative impact to PQ identified or mitigation strategies in place.

requirements.Title: NOA-F Service Parts Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for in-warranty support and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To meet service and warranty obligations, reducing downtime for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available in service parts catalog and distributed to service centers by launch.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed tracking/ID technology) on the bottle lid for authentication or tracking.
requirements.Rationale: To improve product traceability, security, and anti-counterfeiting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids have functional Acumen 6 features as verified by security audit.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and New Bottles
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5, and create molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To enable manufacturing of new components and ensure readiness for Magellan production.
requirements.Dependencies: Final product design, factory readiness, CapEx approval
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines modified and validated for Magellan production requirements.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable for improved serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce service costs and downtime, empowering end users to perform basic maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design, user instructions, safety validation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F using provided instructions without tools, as validated by usability studies.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Increase the warranty page life goal for the printer to 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To offer a more competitive product with longer life and lower total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation updated; field units demonstrate >80K page life in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) Platform as a Service (PaaS) Support
requirements.Description: Support SKU 2 with high throughput and high PDL (Page Description Language) for Platform as a Service (PaaS) business model.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB and enterprise segments with managed print services and higher performance needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, hardware capabilities, service platform integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for PaaS; meets throughput and PDL requirements as per spec.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID for product with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF (Automatic Document Feeder).
requirements.Rationale: To align with new bottle/tank requirements while maintaining compatibility with proven ADF design.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank redesign, mechanical integration, ADF compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes integration and capacity tests; ADF unchanged from Marconi-HI.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Environmental Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To satisfy regulatory and market-driven environmental standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design, materials selection, certification processes
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize product size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and optimize product footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit with final tank design and pass mechanical and usability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) for improved user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience with a larger, more informative display.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display integrated and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement four-tube routing and new integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink flow and reliability for new tank system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes ink flow and reliability tests with new tube configuration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station with aerosol management and spit platform changes to accommodate new tank.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain print quality and reliability with new ink/tank configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system operational and passes reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic and force testing with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path components to support increased page life target of 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability over extended product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass accelerated life testing for 80K pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part to be replaced at service centers after 80K page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: To extend product life and maintain print quality for high-usage customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Part available and service process documented; field replaceable after 80K pages.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in IDS (Ink Delivery System) to support increased tank size and keying.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure secure, reliable, and user-friendly ink connections for new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connections pass reliability, usability, and leak tests.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank design with increased size, new keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) SHAID (presumed sensor/ID) for improved management.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher yield, reduce errors, and improve ink management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank with increased size and SHAID passes functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management system for IDS to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: To address new tank and bottle configuration, ensuring consistent print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm implemented and verified to meet startup and air management KPIs.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion criteria to align with new page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure customer expectations are met for print quality and yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New PQ goals and depletion criteria published and validated through testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU to reduce development cost and risk.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and accelerate time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components integrated and pass system-level validation.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for connectivity and feature support.
requirements.Rationale: To offer wireless connectivity and required firmware features for Magellan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware features operational and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Hardware and Firmware Security
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in hardware and firmware to ensure data and device security.
requirements.Rationale: To meet modern security standards and protect user data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes internal and external security audits for Gauss4.xx features.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Design product and services to support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker solutions.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize market reach and support diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product and services available for all targeted segments at launch.

requirements.Title: Onboarding and S&O Pathways
requirements.Description: Support onboarding and S&O (Setup & Onboarding) paths for Consumer (HPX), HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: To streamline customer onboarding and improve experience across segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All onboarding paths operational and validated in user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability features, and enterprise support for WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM (HP Smart Management), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: To offer a full-featured solution for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution integration, firmware and software support
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan, manageability, and enterprise support features fully functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure broad compatibility and ease of use across platforms and deployment scenarios.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, IT Admins
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers available and validated for Magellan at launch.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Design features and pricing to protect HP’s micro/SMB segment and prevent profit pool erosion to competitors.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain HP’s market share and profitability in key segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in micro/SMB maintained or grown post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Strategically position LaserJet as lead offering and use PDL (presumably Page Description Language-enabled devices) to flank in medium and enterprise segments, targeting Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: To win over competitors and grow share in expanding CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Share gains in medium/enterprise segments and CISS market measured in 12 months post-launch.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS offering into new market segments to grow profitable share.
requirements.Rationale: To capture new revenue streams and outpace competitors as CISS adoption increases.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New segment launches with positive ROI within 18 months post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform and Marconi-Hi Product
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt-LE mechanical platform and Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID) and solutions for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: To accelerate development and reduce cost by reusing proven platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform integration complete with no critical issues before launch.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and new ink tanks into the product platform.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver a cohesive, high-performance ink delivery solution.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All systems integrated and pass end-to-end functional testing.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constrained)
requirements.Description: Maintain SuperAmp PHA (Printhead Assembly) life at 65,000 pages as a non-flexible (constrained) requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure critical component reliability and minimize field failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA consistently meets/exceeds 65K page life in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Provide a 2-year warranty life for the printer as an optimized (somewhat flexible) requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To meet customer expectations and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation published with 2-year coverage; field reliability supports warranty period.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 PPM (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Achieve throughput of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver competitive print speed for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput verified by print speed tests for both SKUs.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – Maintenance Box (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box for improved serviceability, as an optimized requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce downtime and service costs for users and HP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in <5 minutes by trained personnel; validated by service trials.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Develop and support solution features for SMB customers, as an optimized requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB market needs and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solution features available and validated with pilot customers.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Host support for 12,000-page yield CMYK configurations, as a flexible requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To enable future expansion or SKU differentiation if needed.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK configuration validated and ready for future deployment.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Support trade page yield of 6,000 pages as a flexible requirement.
requirements.Rationale: To provide options for different market segments or trade programs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trade page 6K configuration validated and available as needed.
